purpose: Separate pre-contact preparation from evidence that can only be closed through legitimate external Boeing/Spirit engagement and qualified independent review.
external_dependency_barrier: Under the current fail-closed policy, the 98.7 contact threshold cannot be reached solely through internal, synthetic, public-source, public-analog, protocol, or self-review work. Partner-authorized data is a required external state and its absence imposes a 55% hard cap.

pre_contact_work_can_do: prepare data dictionary and import contract
prepare provenance, retention, deletion and deny-path controls
minimum_external_evidence_to_close: written authorization from a legitimate partner authority
identified dataset/sandbox with provenance and use rights

pre_contact_work_can_do: prepare read-only replay and shadow-mode test plans
pre_contact_work_cannot_do: claim shadow or intervention performance on partner workflow
minimum_external_evidence_to_close: pilot closeout evidence with source/configuration digests

pre_contact_work_can_do: retain public analog weaknesses as method evidence
pre_contact_work_cannot_do: claim rework reduction or financial savings
minimum_external_evidence_to_close: effect estimate with uncertainty and confounder review
independent verification of the effect analysis

pre_contact_work_can_do: prepare public Boeing cybersecurity applicability crosswalk
test role separation, TLS, rollback, secrets and deny paths
pre_contact_work_cannot_do: create a CMMC certification or SPRS score

pre_contact_work_can_do: invite a genuinely independent methodology review when appropriate
pre_contact_work_cannot_do: use a methodology-only review to validate unobserved Boeing/Spirit production effects
review partner-specific evidence that does not yet exist
minimum_external_evidence_to_close: qualified reviewer independent of Worldshepherd implementation/authorship
partner-relevant evidence included for partner-specific claims
attributed review disposition and retained evidence digests

pre_contact_completion_definition: all internal synthetic tests pass within their stated scope
public-source crosswalks are current and fail-closed
public manufacturing analog benchmark is reproducible and adverse metrics are retained
partner-pilot, effect-measurement, security and independent-review protocols are structurally complete
external gates remain explicitly missing/partial rather than promoted
no Boeing/Spirit outreach occurs while contact_gate_pass=false
decision_rule: Do not increase the Boeing/Spirit evidence-backed remediation confidence above the hard-cap result by counting preparation artifacts as substitutes for external evidence. Any future gate transition must cite the exact externally authorized evidence that caused the transition.
claims_boundary: This matrix describes evidence dependencies and policy constraints. It is not evidence of Boeing/Spirit engagement, authorization, data access, pilot performance, measured effect, security/compliance approval, independent review, adoption, savings, defect reduction, or remediation probability.
